mapper.select: SELECT DETAIL_SEQ AS detailSeq, CON_SEQ AS conSeq, REG_DATE AS regDate, CON_REMARK AS conRemark, DETAIL_ORDER AS detailOrder, CON_TYPE AS conType, IMAGE_SLIDTYPE AS imageSlidtype, TIME_INTERVAL AS timeInterval FROM TB_CONDETAIL WHERE DETAIL_SEQ = #{detailSeq}::numeric

SELECT A.HIS_SEQ AS hisSeq, B.SCH_CODE AS schCode, D.CON_SEQ AS conSeq, D.CON_FILE AS conFile FROM TB_CONTENTSENDHISTORY A JOIN TB_SCHEDULE B ON A.SCH_CODE = B.SCH_CODE JOIN TB_DIDINFO C ON A.DID_ID = C.DID_ID JOIN TB_CONTENTMUTIL D ON D.CON_SEQ = B.CONTENT_CODE WHERE TO_CHAR(NOW(), 'YYYYMMDD') >= B.SCH_STARTDAY AND B.SCH_ENDDAY >= TO_CHAR(NOW(), 'YYYYMMDD') AND A.CON_PAGEUPDATECHECK = 'N' AND C.DID_ID = #{didId} AND B.SCH_USEYN = 'Y' AND B.SCH_CODE = #{schCode}

SELECT DETAIL_SEQ AS detailSeq, CON_SEQ AS conSeq, REG_DATE AS regDate, CON_REMARK AS conRemark, DETAIL_ORDER AS detailOrder, CON_TYPE AS conType, IMAGE_SLIDTYPE AS imageSlidtype, TIME_INTERVAL AS timeInterval FROM TB_CONDETAIL WHERE CON_SEQ = #{conSeq}::numeric ORDER BY DETAIL_ORDER ASC
SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(DETAIL_SEQ), 0) FROM TB_CONDETAIL WHERE CON_SEQ = #{conSeq}::numeric
SELECT DETAIL_SEQ AS detailSeq, DETAIL_ORDER AS detailOrder FROM TB_CONDETAIL WHERE CON_SEQ = #{conSeq}::numeric
SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(DETAIL_SEQ), 0) FROM TB_CONDETAIL WHERE CON_SEQ = #{conSeq}::numeric AND DETAIL_ORDER = '1'
SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(DETAIL_SEQ), 0) FROM TB_CONDETAIL WHERE CON_SEQ = #{conSeq}::numeric AND DETAIL_ORDER = '2'
SELECT COALESCE(DETAIL_SEQ, 0) FROM TB_CONDETAIL WHERE CON_SEQ = #{conSeq}::numeric AND DETAIL_ORDER = '1'
SELECT COALESCE(DETAIL_SEQ, 0) FROM TB_CONDETAIL WHERE CON_SEQ = #{conSeq}::numeric AND DETAIL_ORDER = '2'
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_CONDETAIL SET CON_SEQ = #{conSeq}, REG_DATE = NOW(), CON_REMARK = #{conRemark,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, DETAIL_ORDER = #{detailOrder,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, CON_TYPE = #{conType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, TIME_INTERVAL = #{timeInterval,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, IMAGE_SLIDTYPE = #{imageSlidtype,jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE DETAIL_SEQ = #{detailSeq}

UPDATE TB_CONDETAIL SET TIME_INTERVAL = ( SELECT TRUNC(COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(CAST(NULLIF(TIME_INTERVAL, '') AS INTEGER), 0)), 0)) FROM TB_CONTENTFILEINFO WHERE DETAIL_SEQ = #{detailSeq}::numeric )::VARCHAR WHERE DETAIL_SEQ = #{detailSeq}::numeric
